leadText: Playground: Pokémon Detective Pikachu (Japanese: 名探偵ピカチュウ プレイ文字パック- Detective Pikachu Playmoji Pack) was a PlayMoji AR pack released for Android on May 2 2019, to coincide with the movie . This feature allowed users to place models of four Pokémon from the movie into a real-world environment.
